title: Alleged Misuse of Facial Recognition Technology by Law Enforcement Reportedly Leading to Wrongful Arrests and Violations of Investigative Standards

behaviors.text: Law enforcement agencies across the U.S.
have allegedly been misusing AI-powered facial recognition technology, leading to wrongful arrests and significant harm to at least eight [person].

Officers have reportedly been bypassing investigative standards, relying on uncorroborated AI matches to build cases, allegedly resulting in prolonged detentions, reputational damage, and personal trauma.
